detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Jurassic World Evolution 3: Deluxe Upgrade Pack features an additional four spectacular prehistoric species of family units; with male, female and juvenile variants:

-            Protoceratops

-            Guanlong

-            Thanatosdrakon

-            Concavenator

The Jurassic World Evolution 3: Deluxe Upgrade Pack also includes a Mosasaurus skin, unique Clark County scenery, and the three ATV skins for the Maintenance Team.
